description: This file defines a Spring component class 'KeycloakManager' responsible for managing Keycloak realm instances, utilizing properties from 'KeycloakProperties'. It provides an abstraction to access Keycloak realms within the application.

classes.name: KeycloakManager
classes.description: A Spring component class that manages Keycloak realm instances using injected properties.
